source: NASA Giovanni MODIS Terra MOD08_D3 Collection 6.1
spatial_method: Giovanni daily bounding-box area average; monthly arithmetic mean of available daily values
qc_note: Exploratory: at least 30% of study days in month and at least one valid day in each of three temporal segments; boundary Oct 2010 excluded. Not scientific final QC.
comparability_note: AOD is Giovanni bounding-box mean, whereas NO2 is province-intersection area-weighted mean; not directly identical spatial support.
map_note: Do not fabricate AOD pixel heatmaps from area-averaged time series.
